info.description:
**A SnappyMail fork focused on integration with Nextcloud.**
SnapMail LT is an independent community fork of SnappyMail for the Nextcloud use case. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Nextcloud GmbH.
SnapMail LT is under active development and provided as-is. Please test it carefully before using it in production. Installation and use are at your own risk.
**Lightweight & fast email client.**
- **Dark mode** - **Responsive design** - **Full Sieve filtering support** - **Date-limited out-of-office messages per account and identity**, with names and addresses loaded automatically from the selected account and flexible per-sender reply intervals for the full absence, daily, weekly or custom use - **Safe multi-instance Sieve handling** that detects and preserves vacation settings created by another SnapMail LT instance and allows explicit removal - **Explicit migration of existing managed Sieve filters** from `rainloop.user` to `snapmail_lt.user`; both scripts remain independently editable until the user deliberately starts the migration - **Almost all IMAP features** including advanced searching - **Integration with Nextcloud Unified Search** - **Integration with other Nextcloud apps** (Contacts, Files and Calendar) - **Multiple mail accounts and identities** - **Integrated Gmail / Google OAuth2 login**, including main account setup from the personal settings and additional Gmail accounts from the webmail account menu - **Administration integrated into Nextcloud**, including mail domains, Google OAuth, webmail settings, extensions and data migration without a separate webmail administrator login - **Domain connection tests** with visible IMAP, SMTP and optional Sieve results - **Protected shared CardDAV settings** that cannot be overwritten while an additional mail account is active - **Admin-assisted import from existing SnappyMail installations**, including stored mailbox credentials, additional accounts and app data - **Admin reset option** to remove SnapMail LT account settings and recreate a clean SnapMail LT data folder when troubleshooting is needed - **Admin-controlled message list size**, including default value, maximum value and an optional enforced setting for all users - **Send & receive OpenPGP encrypted/signed emails** (With full HTML support, ECC keys, or plain text with Mailvelope) - **Send & receive S/MIME encrypted/signed emails** - **Many security features** (Sodium encrypted passwords, Sec-Fetch, TOTP 2FA, DKIM, prevent tracking, etc.) - **Kolab integrations**
After enabling the app, administrators can manage the complete webmail configuration in the dedicated "SnapMail LT" section of the Nextcloud administration settings without a separate webmail administrator login. Users can add their initial mailbox credentials in the dedicated "SnapMail LT" section of their personal settings.
Administrators can also use the SnapMail LT administration settings to import data from an existing SnappyMail installation or reset SnapMail LT data for troubleshooting.
